text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P2 core scalability. Current PreparedFitContext in FitInterpreter.scala captures runChunk/combine functions, so the durable descriptor requirement is still real. FitChunks already supplies chunk plans/programs and selected reads; selected OLS/estimate sinks also exist. Do not restart bounded execution or force outputs back into full dense retention. Remaining scope is immutable versioned descriptors with explicit interpreter/provider capabilities and preparation topology, then engine-specific read-budget evidence including global reductions and missing-data pattern discovery. Separate serializable scientific work from scheduler lifecycle, and keep per-run time series/structural axes/covariance intact. Do not assume every engine is block-local or claim an existing in-process prepared closure round-trips. Keep P2 behind immediate correctness/PHRF, and allow already supported bounded OLS/persistence paths to proceed independently of the full engine serialization program. Source assessment only; no new round-trip/runtime test.
